title: BeginnerUploadGallery
description: A small upload gallery API where registered users upload text or image-like files, list their own uploaded filenames, and download one of their files by name.
generation_notes: Use deterministic file content and metadata so tests can verify upload and download behavior.
Do not depend on image processing libraries or external scanners.
The security angle should be plausible around filenames, file ownership, and accepted file types.
scenario_instructions: Handle uploaded filenames carefully and avoid exposing files across users.
